heading: born_mdm: phishing
body:
DO NOT click the link or reply. Do not download attachments. Hover the sender name to reveal the actual email address — phishing often uses look-alike domains (microsft.com vs microsoft.com).

Asked by: born_mdm | Topic: phishing | If this does not resolve in two attempts, that is an L2 escalation — call (647) 581-3182.
query_seed: is the phishing fix enough, or what breaks it at scale?
